loads.notes: High Desert precision load. Optimized for 6.5 PRC in 26" barrel. 44.8gr H4350, Alpha brass, Federal 210M, COAL 2.955". Avg MV: 2910 fps, ES: 11 fps, SD: 4.2 fps over 10 shots.
SE Load A 200gr Speer Hot-Cor, H4895. Moderate velocity, proven deer penetration. Testing for stability in thick brush conditions. MV ~2400 fps.
SE Load B 210gr Barnes TTSX, Varget. Monolithic copper for reliable expansion. Tested for bone-busting performance at close range. MV ~2330 fps.

loads.handloadName: 225gr Speer Grand Slam SP / IMR 4064 (Load C)
loads.notes: SE Load C 225gr Speer Grand Slam, IMR 4064. Heaviest projectile tested. Max penetration for quartering shots. MV ~2220 fps.

Michigan bear load 180gr Nosler Partition, H4350. The Partition's dual-core design provides reliable front-end expansion with rear-core penetration retention. Ideal for close-range tree shots requiring maximum tissue disruption. MV ~2700 fps.
